# EverythingStar FOSS

> A free, non-commercial library of UltraStar songs converted for EverythingStar and Guitar Hero-compatible players, with separated stems and licence details on every song page.

EverythingStar FOSS is a static song library published by HappyPaul55. Each song folder works in EverythingStar, Clone Hero and YARG. The songs, lyrics, artwork and charts keep their own licences — see each song's `license.txt` — while the site's own code is MIT. Nothing here may be sold or put behind a paywall.

## Main pages

- [EverythingStar FOSS](https://everythingstar-foss.happypaul55.com/): what the library is, its numbers and featured songs.
- [Songs](https://everythingstar-foss.happypaul55.com/songs): the full list, with search and 30-second previews.
- [Attribution](https://everythingstar-foss.happypaul55.com/ATTRIBUTION.md): the licences and credits for the library.
- [Playlist JSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HappyPaul55/everythingstar-foss/main/songs/playlist.json): the playlist document a player reads.

## Elsewhere

- [Play with EverythingStar](https://everythingstar.happypaul55.com): the game that reads this library.
- [Source code](https://github.com/HappyPaul55/everythingstar-foss): the repository behind the library.
- [HappyPaul55](https://www.happypaul55.com): the publisher.
